tei:div.tei:p: (195) ༄༅// rgyud lugs 'jam dpal zhi ba'i bsnyen pa gtong ba'i lag len zin thun mdor bsdus bzhugs// (196)

༄༅/ zab brling sras bcas rgyal ba'i gsung rab don// rnam 'byed blo gros spobs pa'i gter chen brgyad// dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs mchog 'jam dpal gyi// rigs sngags sgrub pa'i lag len bsnyel byang bri/ de la dam pa gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing bkra shis pa'i gnas su/ nyi ma byang bgrod kyi ra ba'i yar ngor gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shis pa'i dus su/ dad dang mos gus phun sum tshogs pas dbang thob dam tshig dag cing shes rab rno la lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan pas/ 'tsho ba zas gos/ nad zlog sman/ dgra zlog mtshon/ bgegs zlog thun/ sgrub dang mchod rdzas 'dzom pas bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas lam 'dir 'jug ste/ thog mar dkon mchog gi rten la mchod 'bul/ mdo rgyud gsung sgrog dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ sats+tsha 'debs pa/ srog bslu nye'u 'don/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gtor 'bul dang gsol skong*/ bsang brngan gser skyems/ chu sbyin dang lan chags gtor ma/ klung bskyed dang lam 'phrang bcos pa/ phyag bskor maṇ+ḍal/ tshogs skong dang rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ bdag 'jug blang ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs ci 'grub byas pas bar chad mi 'byung ba dang*/ dngos grub myur ba'i dgos pa yod/ de nas dgra gnyen nor rdzas gzugs 'dzin chags sdang nyon mongs rnam rtog gi dbang du song ba'i ngan dred dang 'bri klog 'dzin pa bsam mno gtong ba sogs kyi bzang dred min par/ ltogs 'khyag shi chad gang la'ang sdug sran bskyed de snying rus chen pos sgrub pa 'di mthar 'don pa'i dam bca'/ thun gyi sngon 'gro bzhi dang ldan pas thun mong dang khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la (197) gnad du bsnun/ las gzhung gi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag brgyad pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas cha gsum gtang*/ bgegs bskrad zin nas/ sgo drung du tho dkar po brtsegs pa la rgyal chen bzhi'i sku'am sngags byang 'dzu+ugs/

mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe ne wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ye hūm̐: gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por 'bar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlab/ tho bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las shar du rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ/ lhor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri/ nub tu spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten/ byang du rnam thos sras ser po be con dang ne'u le 'dzin pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chan po sde bzhi 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa bstim/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa ya swa hāḥ oṃ bai ru dha kā ya swa hāḥ oṃ bi ru pak+ṣa ya swa hāḥ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya swa hāḥ a r+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'a ི bar gyis mchod/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyis gtor ma 'bul/ zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ (198) /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// phyogs bzhi'i bgegs kyi mtshams chod cig ces dang*/ sngags kyi mthar/ tiṣ+tha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ sgrub khang gi phyogs so sor rang rang gi rgyal thabs dpung dang bcas te bsrung bar bsam/ de nas bsrung 'khor brtan po bsgom/ bya byed las gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i de kho na'i srung ba bya/ srung 'khor 'di thun mgo thams cad du gsal btab nas bskyar zhing mtshams grol rgyu'i nub tha ma'i tshe ma gtogs mi bsdu/ 'di skabs mi 'phrad ka med kyi mi dang zas gos sogs gzhan nas 'ong dgos pa thams cad dmigs rdel bzhag la srung 'khor du 'jug

dam bca' thung se bas yun bsring*/ mtshams bya rgyu'i lha 'di'o zhes su la'ang mi smra/ mal 'og tu sa dkar gyis dga' 'khyil bri/ sgrub pa ma thon bar du gzhan don mi bya/ chos mi bshad/ gnas mi spo/ stan mi sprug gdong dang lag pa mi bkru/ skra dang kha spu mi 'dreg gzhan gyi gos mi gyon/ zas mi bza'/ lto ha cang che ba dang chung ba mi bya/ me sogs la phu mi bya/ mchil snabs phyir mi 'dor/ stan la drod yal du mi 'jug/ sgrug rdzas mi la mi bstan/ khyi dang bud med mi 'grogs/ rang gi thig le mi nyams/ kha mi bshal bar sngags mi bzla/ mdze po dang*/ sdig can nang du mi 'jug thog steng du'ang 'grim mi 'jug rgog gtsong la phug lan tshwa rnams dang*/ khyad par lce sha mi bza'/ rang gi mal sar gzhan mi btang*/ sdod du mi 'jug gos gzhan la mi bkon/ mtshon rtse khar mi 'jug gzhu mi phab/ mda' mi bcag mtshon cha'i rigs mi 'gom/ (199) mi gcog gos dreg pa can mi gyon/ snod gas chag can mi spyad/ rtags mtshan gzhan la mi bshad/ dmigs 'og tu ma chud pa'i mi phar mi mthong ba dang*/ des kyang rang tshur ma mthong bar bya/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i sgrub pa lhag pa'i dam tshig nyi shu po rnams kyang legs par bsrung ngo*/ khyad par mtshams dbu btsu+ugs nas ma grol bar du ngag sdom pa ni gnad gal po che'o/ dgong mo lha dbang du bsdu ba'i dus nas brtsams te thun mgo 'dzin pas sngar srung 'khor grub pa'i rjes nyid du byin 'bebs nas brtsams te las gzhung gtong dgos pas/ dzapra la bab pa na/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gsal ba'i zhabs mthil du// yaṃ las rlung sngon gzhu dbyibs ba dan can// 'doms su raṃ las me dkyil gru gsum dmar// lte bar baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum// de steng snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor// ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lter// dzi haṃ dmar po 'od zer me zad 'phro// snying khar hūm̐ mthing mgrin par āḥdamar po// spyi bor haṃ yig dkar zhing bsil bar bsam// hūm̐ ha a dzhaiṃ/

dzhaiṃ las 'od dmar sgra bcas rlung byung bas// rkang mthil rlung bcas cher g.yos nam mkhar 'degs// rlung gis me sbar chu khol sa g.yos pas// yi ge gsum bskul bde chen bzod med 'bar// 'od kyis lus gang sna bug g.yas nas byung*// snod bcud zhu zhing 'od zhu g.yo zhing bskyod// 'jam pa'i dpal sogs sras bcas rgyal ba bskul// sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan rnam par byon// rang la thim pas byin gyis ba brlabs (200) par gyur/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ hūm̐ ha a dzhaiṃ: zhes pa 'bum drug sngon du 'gro bas gzhung gi dmigs pa dang bstun nas grangs bsnyen gzhung gsal rnams dang*/ a ra pa tsa 'bru 'bum btang dgos pas/ dmigs rim rnams kun 'byung nor bu'i rgyal po bzhin 'don bder bsdebs na/ rlung phyir 'byin tshe/ thugs ka'i dhiḥyig na dā las// sngags phreng dmar ser oṃ nas brtsams// dril lu sgrar bcas nar gyis byung// sor drug nam mkha' g.yas su 'khor/ rlung nang du rngub tshe/ oṃ nas sgra bcas nar gyis drangs// dh-iḥl thim pas 'od kyis lus// gang zhing dhiḥl rig pa gtad// dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga'i 'od// 'phros pas snod bcud rgud pa zhi// dpal byor spel zhing dwangs bcud bkug /gnod byed tshar bcad snang srid kun// 'od gsal chos skur 'byams klas bsam// snod bcud rtsa sngags dbyangs gsal gyi/ yi ge kha dog sna tshogs pa'i// phra rab rdul gyi rang bzhin can// shig shig g.yo ba rang la thim// thugs kar dpal be'u zur drug nang// dhiḥyig dmar ser sngags kyis bskor// gre phug ā yig dkar por bsam// snying ga'i sngags las 'od zer 'phros// phyogs dus rgyal ba'i gzungs spobs dang*// srid zhi'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa// 'od dmar ā li kā li'i tshogs// bsdus pas lus nang mer gyis gang*// dwangs ma sa bon la 'dus pas// spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol bar bsam/

zhes 'bum phrag nyer brgyad las mi nyung bar bzla/ bh+rum̐/ mkha' dkyil bh+rum̐ las rdo (201) rje'i gur// phyi nas me mtshon khol ba'i nang// bdag dang srung bya thams cad tshud// thugs dbus bh+rum̐ yig ser po gsal/ bh+rum̐ḥ zhes 'bum phrag gsum/ thugs ka'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis// gnod par byed pa de dag kun// lhag ma med par zhi nas kyang// gang 'dod grub mchog thob par bsam/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥmuḥ zhes pa 'bum phrag sum cu bzla/ thugs kar zla steng oṃ āḥhūm̐// brtsegs ma sngags kyis bskor ba las// 'od kyis lus gang sdig sgrib dag /rgyal ba'i yonatan bsdus par bsam/ oṃ ā hūm̐ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes 'bum phrag tsam bzla/ sngags kyi 'od las dmigs bya'i sgrib// sbyangs shing ye shes snang ba rgyas/ oṃ a dhi ra hūm̐/ khe tsa ra grog maṃ swa hā/ zhes 'bum phrag tsam bzla/ spyi bor a ā mig i ī// sna la u ū lcer ṛ ṝ// rna bar l̥ l̥̄ snying ga ru// e ā+ai lag gnyis o ā+au dang*// rdo rje'i rtse mor aṃ yig dang*// 'og sgor ā rnams gzugs brnyan ltar// dmar 'od lham me gsal bar gyur/ zhes rtsa sngags dang a li sbrel ma khri gcig bzla/ bum par 'jam dpal gsal ba'i thugs// zla dbus dhi'aḥmathar rtsa sngags dang*/ ka lis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// 'khor 'das tshe bcud bum lhar bsdus// bdud rtsis bum pa mer gyis gang*/ rtsa sngags dang ka li sbrel ma khri thems par bzla/ thugs kar dhī yig sngags phreng mthar// rten 'brel snying pos bskor ba dang*// g.yas pa'i mchog sbyin mthil du ni// sangs rgyas (202) bcom ldan 'das nyid bzhugs/ zhes mos la rtsa sngags dang ye dhar sbrel ma 'bum phrag gcig bzla/ rang lus 'jam dpal 'od lus stong sangs sku yi dbus drang por// ye shes dbu ma mthe'u chung tshad tsam gsang gnas nas bzung spyi bo'i bar// mar sne phug rdugs yar sne'i rtsa 'dabs dbang po'i sgo la ha rer zug

/stong sangs mthing mdog de yi nang du rig pa'i ngo bo 'od zlum po// phyi nang mu khyud du ma'i nang na rtsa sngags sa bon dang bcas pa// shel dkar phreng ltar lu gu rgyud kyi bar na 'od lnga'i snang ba 'bar// de 'dras dbu ma'i nang kun gang bas nam kha'i dbyings kun khyab par rgyur/ sngags yid bzlas bya/ thugs srog sngags kyi 'od zer gyis// 'khor 'das tshe bcud kun bsdus nas// rang sems gnyug ma'i thig ler thim// 'gyur med gnas su rgyas gdab pas// ye shes rdo rje'i tshe 'grub bsam/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ oṃ nṛ bh+ruṃ badz+ra dz+nya na a u ṣe hūm̐ āḥ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ thun mthar mchod bstod dang*/ bka' srung gtor 'bul/ tshogs skong sogs rgyas par bya rjes/ bsdu sdang bsngo smon bkra shis sogs byas nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la zhugs/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis har gyis langs nas lus gnad drang por bsrang/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal zhing ngag byin gyis brlabs/ sems gnad kun slong bcos nas bla ma gsol ba gdab/ thun mong sngon bgros rgyud sbyangs nas/ lha yi rnal 'byor la zhugs/ bzlas pa'i sham du/ rang lus 'jam dpal stong gsal rang bzhin rtsa bsum 'khor lo bzhi bcas gsal// thugs srog sngags las ye shes bdud rtsis rtsa gnas thams cad bkrus pa las// nad (203)gdon nyes tshogs sngo dmar rlangs pa dbang sgo ba spu'i khung nas thon// lus nang thams cad bdud rtsis gang bas bdai drod lhag par 'bar bar gyur/ de yang tsha ba la mdog dkar po bsil ba'i rnam pa/ grang bar dmar po tsha ba'i rnam pa/ rlung sogs dang nad spyi la dmar ser bde ba'i rnam pa can bsgom la thun gcig lhar gsal 'od kyis bcing pa krol// zug pa dbyung la mnan pa bshig /gtad pa thams cad hrul bar bsam/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ a shig shig phyung phyung khrol khrol swa hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la thod pa'i nang du chang dang a mṛ ta sbyar ba la btab ste de nyid ye shes bdud rtsir mos pa lce rdo rjer bsams pa'i thog thig pa gsum bzhag

gnas gsum du'ang thig pa gsum gsum bzhag go thugs ka'i sngags bcas gre par mūṃ yig dmar ser nyid las 'od 'phros pas// phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin dang chabs gcig bdag gi ngag nus brkus pa kun/ khab len lcags bzhin bsdus nas mūṃ la thim pas bdud rtsi dmar ser gyis// ngag mnan la sogs nyes pa sbyangs nas rang lus ltem me gang bar gyur/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ ma te 'ur ba naṃ khrolaḥ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ lce ti 'ur ba naṃ khrolaḥ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ tsa ti 'ur ba naṃ khrol: oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ ma ma dā+e ba khrol phye: oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ sa me khrol phye: zhes nyer gcig bzla/ rang nyid lhar gsal pha lam las grub ljags ni ral gri dmar po'i lter/ (204) /'bru gsum brtsegs ma sngags kyis bskor mthar dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po dmar// sngags phreng 'od kyis sras bcas rgyal ba'i gsung gi byin rlabs dbyangs gsal gyi// rnam par spyan drangs lce la thim pas sngags kyi nus pa rgyas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi/ pra war+dha na ye swa hāḥ hri badz+ra dz+wi ho man+t+ra dha ra wad+dha ni oṃ/ dbyangs gsal rten snying btags pa nyer gcig sngags nyid lce la bstim pas rgyal ba'i gsung gi rdo rjer ro gcig gyur/ de rnams sbyar nas thun mthar mchod bstod bshags gsum/ bsdu ldang/ bsngo smon bkra shis brjod nas thor thun grol/ rgyun gyis yi dam rnams kha tags/ snga thun la/ brgyud 'debs skyabs sems nas brtsams/ bkra shis man sngar ltar/ chu gtor dang dkar gsur btang*/ gung tshigs bya/ phyi thun la/ brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems nas bzlas pa mchod bstod yan/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul dang/ grub na tshogs bskang sogs bya/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis bcas kyis grol/ srod thun la/ brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems nas/ bzlas pa mchod bstod rjes/ bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis bcas bya'o//

gzhan yang chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gsung las/ rgyun du rang nyid yi dam lha de'i sku gsung thugs dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal ma bral ba'i ngang*/ bzlas pa phreng skor re sogs mtshams su sems can rnams la bcos min gyi snying rje'i shugs drag po re dang*/ bla ma la mos gus gdung bas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa'i gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa dang*/ yi dam la lha mchog thugs rje'i 205) bdag nyid khyed rang mkhyen snyam pa'i yid khyed shes kyi blo gtad ling bskyur byed pa rnams/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i sgo dam pa yin par gsungs pa dang*/ lhag par rkyen ngan slong ba dang*/ re dogs 'khu 'phrig gi bsam pa shar dus na na'ang na go chod/ shi na'ang shi go chod/ da res sgrub pa 'di ma thon gyi bar du rkyen ngan bar chad kyi dbang du gtong re shi'am snyam du zhe dam drag po chag med du bya dgos pa dang*/ thun bzhi ma ha cang thun khrigs mang bas bzlas pa la 'gor na thun gsum mam gnyis su dril ba'i phyag len kyang yod/ de'i tshe thor thun dang snga thun gcig tu bya zhing*/ dgong thun dang srod thun gcig tu byas pas bzlas pa mang du 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod/ thun ji ltar thung yang bzlas pa 'bru bco lnga tshun stong phrag ma song bas mi rung*/ thun mtshams ji ltar ring yang thun gyi bzhi cha las ring ba mi rung ba yang spyi tsam du shes par bya'o/ zhes 'byung*/ yang rgyal sras rin rnams zhal nas/ spyir bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir shes par bya ba ni shes pa bying nas gnyid bro ba sogs byung na rig pa ngar bskyed cing blo dpang bstod de sngags sgra dang bcas par bzla/ shes pa thams cad rgod nas dmigs pa mi gsal na ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' kho na la sems bzung ste shub bur bzla/ 'jig rten gyi rnam rtog la g.yengs nas sun nyams byung na bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzod sran dka' spyad kyi tshul la gzhigs ste hur bskyed/

rtsa khams dwangs pa dang lce bde ba'i dus su sngags 'gro che na brod kha mi bya/ de las ldog na snying rus bskyed/ spyir yang mtshams gyi 'go la lhod pa/ bar du dam pa/ rjes su lhod par byed/ khams gseng ba sogs kyi dus phreng ba la mdud pa rgyab pa khro zhal du dmigs nas gdan khar bzhag pas

206) stan srung*/ zhes sogs 'byung ngo*/ mtshams grol ba'i snga nub dngos grub kyi rdzas bshams/ phyir nyin snga bar langs nas/ las byang*/ tshogs bsgral bstab rjes dngos grub blang ba skya rengs dang thug par bya/ lhag ma gtong dus brtson 'dzin byas pa'ang phyir 'bul/ bka' srung gtor 'bul/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa/ rten bzhugs bsdu ldang bcas grub nas/ kha skong bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg kyang 'grub na legs/ tho drung du phyin te rgyal chen la mchod gtor 'dzugs dus ltar la/ bstod pa'i gsham/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: zhes kha bsgyur te slar phrin las gsol/ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs gsol bgyid de tho 'grol/ bsngo smon bkra shis rnams rgyas par bya/ mtshams grol ma thag mig dgra phyogs su blta ba dang*/ nyi zla'i phyogs su blta/ rten gsum la phyag mchod dang spang kong phyag rgya pa bklag sats+tsha chu sbyin sogs bya/ dam gtsang re gnyis dang 'phrad/ de nas rim bzhin yangs par byas te grib dang bags kyis 'dris su 'jug pa gal che'o// 'dir brtson zhugs rnams spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol/ /gzhung lugs smra la thogs med blo thob nas// 'jam pa'i rdo rjes rjes su bzung ba dang*// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i phan bde'i byed por shog ces pa'ang blo gros gsal ba thub bstan bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi thugs bzhed skong phyir gtsug gi nor bu mdzod lnga'i shing rta 'jam mgon rdo rje blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ smra ba'i seng ge mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung las btus te rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pas so// dge'o//
